difference.reason: Retain the native singular filter model/write format for existing documents and integrations; import the Obsidian spelling at the read boundary.

features.title: Global AND view filters

features.title: Recursive and/or/not groups

features.title: Comparison operators
features.notes: Standard comparisons, including double-equals, execute through the same lowering boundary as formulas; native single-equals remains accepted.

features.title: Symbolic boolean operators and truthiness
features.notes: Symbolic logic and numeric truthiness are compiled to boolean predicates before evaluation.

features.title: Bare, note-dot and bracket properties
features.notes: Bracketed note keys use typed literal-key lookups, preserving whitespace, dots and reserved names.

features.title: Arithmetic and precedence
features.notes: Arithmetic precedence, grouping, unary minus, division and modulo.

features.title: Formula references in filters
features.notes: Dotted and bracketed formula references resolve through the same execution compiler without rewriting string literals.

features.title: Formula chains and formula sorting
features.notes: Formula chains preserve arithmetic precedence and both formula-ID spellings sort by evaluated values.

features.title: this binding
features.notes: A query has no owning-note binding in BasesTable or QueryController; real embed ownership needs a host fixture.

difference.reason: Host-specific this binding needs an explicit owning-file context contract; do not infer it from a global App.

features.title: Date fields and arithmetic

features.title: File fields

features.title: Frontmatter links resolve as typed links
